test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As per Reserve Bank of India (Regulatory Framework for Microfinance Loans) Directions, 2022, a microfinance loan is defined as a collateral-free loan given to a household having annual household income up to _________ . For this purpose, the household shall mean an individual family unit, i.e., husband, wife, and their unmarried children.
solution:
The correct answer is** __₹3,00,000__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **microfinance loan** is defined as a **collateral-free loan** granted to a household with an** annual household** income of up to **₹3,00,000** in accordance with **Reserve Bank of India (Regulatory Framework for Microfinance Loans) Directions, 2022**.
 
• The term ***"*****household*****" ***in this context refers to a single family unit, consisting of a husband, wife, and any unmarried children.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• All **collateral-free loans** supplied to** low-income households**, defined as **households** with annual incomes up to ₹3,00,000, will be regarded as **microfinance loans**, regardless of end use and manner of **application**,** processing**, or **disbursal** (either through physical or digital channels).
 
• The loan cannot be secured by a lien on the **borrower's deposit account** in order to maintain the **microfinance loan's collateral-free status**.
 
• The REs must have a **board-approved policy** that allows them to customize the** repayment schedule** for micro-loans to meet the needs of the **borrowers.**

60:T
